names.en: Empty shampoo, soap or detergent bottle
names.hi: शैम्पू, साबुन या डिटर्जेंट की खाली बोतल

en: Put it in the blue bin with the cap on
hi: ढक्कन लगाकर नीले डिब्बे में डालें

impact.en: Rinsed bottles are easy to recycle; leftover soap spoils other recyclables.
impact.hi: धुली बोतलें आसानी से रीसायकल होती हैं; बचा साबुन दूसरी चीज़ें ख़राब करता है।

sources: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 (MoEFCC): four-stream segregation, https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2219676
SBM-Urban, Guidelines for Source Segregation of Municipal Solid Waste, https://sbmurban.org/storage/app/media/pdf/Guidelines%20for%20Source%20Segregation%20of%20Municipal%20Solid%20Waste.pdf
